page.layout: One printed page (right page of the opening). Running head at top with page number at top right. Verse stanzas in one column, with line numbers 12 to 16 in the left margin beside the verses. Below: a centred title "ARGVMENTA CAPITVM ex G. F.", then "CAPVT I." and a short argument with line numbers 2 and 3 at the left. The left strip of the scan is the edge of the neighbouring page and is left out.

main_text.l: Quantaque sit virtus fidei : quo numine missu
Haec faciat, Dominum gens odiosa rogat.
12 Agricolae ingrati pelluntur : reddite censum.
Et caro de putri nostra resurget humo.
Maxima lex quae sit : CHRISTVS Dauide creatus,
Factus inest Scribis : aera minuta probat.
13 Clara cadent tandem Solymorum moenia : pravos
Affligent : Sanctos multa pericla manent.
Hinc docet extremae quae nam sit forma diei
Quae cunctis vigili corde notanda venit.
14 Vnguentis redolent crines : hunc vendit Iudas.
Instituit mortis symbola sacra suae.
Vota patri fundit, capitur telisque dolisque.
Diffugiunt : forti percutit ense Petrus.
Pontifices captum condemnant : caeditur insons :
Doctoremque negas territe Petre tuum.
15 Traditur Ausonio Praetori : Barraban alta
Voce petunt, CHRISTVM damnat iniqua manus.
Fertque crucem propriam : clavis configitur insons.
Distribuunt vestes : impia probra sonant.
Tristia sed mortem comitantur signa nefandam
Et tumulant sanctae mortua membra manus.
16 Angelus attonitis Mariis facta omnia narrat.
Appares variis, CHRISTE supreme, modis.
Infirmos culpat, totumque ablegat in orbem.
Relliquis terris summa sub astra volat.
main_text.head: ARGVMENTA CAPITVM ex G. F.
CAPVT I.
main_text.l: Daemonium pellit cum febre, cumque lepra.
2 Blasphemum reputant. sequitur Matthaeus. utrisque
Rumpuntur. pellis spica vexulsa famem.
3 Cura manus. fuga spirituum. cognomina bis sex.
Regnum divisum non stat, adesque parens.

page.notes: The initial letter of the argument is a large drop cap, read as A; the first word reads "Eluitur", so the joined form is doubtful and given as "AEluitur". "Appares" and "Relliquis" are read from a small, slightly worn print and may be misread. "Blasphemum" and "utrisque" are the line-start words of the argument, copied as printed. The left strip shows the adjacent page's text and is excluded. A large dark mark near the lower centre is a stain.
